select
from template_task tt left join (select a.task_id,a.template_id,string_agg(b.id, ',') as id,string_agg(b.name, ',') as name from template_pre_task a inner join template_task b ON a.pre_task_id = b.id and a.template_id = b.template_id group by a.task_id,a.template_id) tpt on tt.id = tpt.task_id and tt.template_id = tpt.template_id left join (select task_id,template_id,string_agg(docs_name, ',') as docsNames from template_delivery_docs group by template_id, task_id) tdd on tt.id = tdd.task_id and tt.template_id = tdd.template_id
and tt.name like concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword} ,'%')
and tt.template_id like concat('%', #{params.templateId} ,'%')
order by tt.create_time asc
